notes.title: Custom Countdown Screensavers
notes.content:
You can now create custom countdown screensavers by clicking the button on the main screen.

-Jeff Minnis

notes.title: Customizable Falling Characters
notes.content:
Enjoy the customizable falling characters in the custom countdowns!

-Jeff Minnis

notes.title: Improved Time Display
notes.content:
Improved the formatting on the time display to remove extra 0s at beginning. Less unneeded donuts :)

-Jeff Minnis

notes.title: Countdown to Event
notes.content:
Create multiple custom countdowns. You can use it for any upcoming event, birthday, holiday or even to count up for age and other anniversaries. Free demo today. Make sure you add to your wishlist.
